text.tspan: only if X's index gateway still runs:

g.text: withdraw own ns-foo rows (if not the last)
t0 + ~85 to 95 s: suspect (3 misses + heartbeat window)
HandleSuspectNode: disable X's ns-foo rows (not the last)

text.tspan: t0 + 120 s: reaper marks X inactive,

g.text: ReplaceClusterNode: swap X's IP for the replacement's IP

text.tspan: t0 + 15 min: purge deletes any remaining active rows of X
(gateway rows never emptied; TURN rows deleted outright)
cached answers live for the record TTL (60 s ns-, 300 s base)
